title: Bug 641489: Show Next/Previous Operation No. on routing lines when Type = Parallel
summary: Next Operation No. and Previous Operation No. fields on routing lines now automatically show when routing type is Parallel instead of remaining hardcoded invisible, eliminating the need for manual personalization.
key_points: Next and Previous Operation No. are no longer hardcoded hidden on the Routing Lines and Routing Version Lines subforms
Fields show when routing Type is Parallel and hide when it is Serial
New public SetParallelFieldsVisible setter on the subforms controls visibility
Routing and Routing Version cards call the setter from OnAfterGetRecord and the Type field OnValidate
Change also applied to the IT layer routing subforms
